title: Aeronautical
description: A small modpack built around Create: Aeronautics, with a few other things.
body:
# Aeronautical!

This modpack is build around **Create: Aeronautics**. It is for **NeoForge** on **1.21.1**.

Most things in this pack are addons for Create, with Aeronautics being the main focus, as well as a decent amount of quality of life mods, all intended to facilitate your factory building wants and needs.

Comes with ore deposits on the surface, for a Satisfactory-like feeling. Also facilitates quicker progression, so you're not stuck in early game minecraft for hours and you can get to the fun Create stuff a little quicker.

Mod lists are in the changelogs of each version.

## Known issues
- Rendering issues with Iris shaders on simulated contraptions. I can't find a workaround, it's a known issue with Sable too.
- Rendering issues with Distant Horizons and simulated contraptions. Might be fixed by increasing CPU usage, but I can't test that without blowing up my PC, sorry.
